text:
Priya: Quick ping — PR #2564 is ready for merge aside from two tiny style nits (gofmt + proto json tag). CI shows the gofmt failure and one proto linter warning. We want to land this in today's 17:00 release window. Can someone with merge perms give a quick review? @Lee @Marta

Sam: On it, will scan now. If it’s only formatting I can push a followup commit or request a `gofmt -w` from the author. What’s the proto tag issue?

Priya: Thanks. The proto issue is a json_name mismatch on the new field (camelCase vs snake_case). Push would be fine — I can update the proto if you prefer.

Sam: If you can patch the proto, easiest. Otherwise I can do a tiny commit to fix tags and run `make proto` locally.

Lee: I don’t have merge perms on this repo (my access is org-level only), but I can approve the PR review-wise. @Marta or @Sam need to hit merge when approvals + CI are green.

Marta: I can merge once CI is green and we have 2 approvals. I saw the gofmt diff — it's just a line break in a long comment. If you want me to land and squash, say the word. :+1:

Priya: Squash + merge is fine. I’ll push the proto fix in a sec. Will ping once done.

CI-Bot: build/verify — gofmt failed on 3 files. proto-lint reported 1 warning (json_name mismatch).

Priya: Pushed proto tag fix and ran `gofmt`. PTAL.

Sam: Re-running CI locally — looks clean now. Leaving a small nit about a variable name (ctx vs requestCtx) but it’s not blocking. Approving now.

Lee: Approve from me too. Small naming nit noted but can be followup.

Marta: CI is green on GitHub Actions. I’m merging this into release branch now (squash+merge). Will update changelog entry.

Priya: Thanks all! Will follow up with a tiny naming cleanup in a separate PR. :)

Marta: Cheers. If anyone spots regressions in staging, ping #eng-oncall.
